mismatches.reason: The intent is an unconditional requirement that no-op-with-value swaps revert, but the predicate conditions it on not-stuck_eth_extractable, adding an unrelated antecedent.

V (no extraction and no-op-with-value not reverting) does not contradict I, since I only requires reverting when stuck_eth_extractable is false, which V also asserts, so V is consistent with rather than a violation of I.
